changes.full_model_loadable: Loader completed conditionally; exact source SPPR unsupported and all3 diagnostic configurations FAIL
changes.loadability_class: Source tables extracted; conditional loader run completed, scientific diagnostics FAIL
changes.quality_rationale: Historical numeric quality scores have not been reassessed. Source tables extracted; conditional loader run completed, scientific diagnostics FAIL. See source/model extraction evidence; this is not production adoption.
changes.recommendation: Complementary 2023 candidate; not selected. Fifty-four censored diet cells remain unresolved; conditional GE/TE/With Egestion diagnostics FAIL and both MC methods accept0/100.
changes.notes: Chen 2023 candidate has 25 groups. Exact model not selected. Source-faithful extraction preserves censored inputs and missing BA/GS/routing. Source hashes, import files, canonical JSON, taxonomy and validation retained. Fifty-four diet cells are censored + values. Bounded conditional loader run used100 draws per MC method and180s/method. GE/TE/With Egestion all FAIL; both MC methods accepted0/100 and rejected100/100 as divergent. Numeric outputs depend on loader zeroing censored diet entries, normalization and filling missing inputs, and are not source-faithful production results. Negative source groups retained, including groups whose catch was unknown and loader-completed to zero. Evidence: regions/LME_049/models/49_20252023_Kuroshio_Oyashio_Extension_Chen_(2023)/extracted_tables/REPORT.md
changes.coverage_note: 2023 offshore Kuroshio-Oyashio Extension survey domain148–164E,35–45N. Partial LME applicability. Inherited paper coverage ratio retained as history and not newly validated; no numerical ratio assigned to the new candidate.
